text:
Maria: Heads-up — seeing SMART warnings + transient read-only remounts on several ephemeral nodes in eu-west-1b. nvme0 shows increasing wear, and IO wait spikes during nightly batch/cleanup window. One node had fs errors on /scratch and had to be remounted read-only.
AJ: Which instances / instance family? logs?
Maria: m5d.4xlarge and c6i with local NVMe. Dmesg snippet:

```
[1801234567.123456] nvme nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, completed 0 of 32
[1801234567.123460] BTRFS warning (device nvme0n1p1): read failed, dev nvme0n1p1 sector 12345678
[1801234567.123470] EXT4-fs error (device nvme0n1p1): ext4_readpage: bad geometry
```

NVME-CLI smart output shows media_errors and high prog_erase_count on a few disks.
Devon: Hmm — nightly ephemeral-cleaner runs at 03:00 and does parallel rm -rf on /scratch/* (concurrency via xargs -P 16). That can spike IOPS when combined with batch job output. Could be wear + heavy delete IO causing controller hiccups.
Sam: Agreed. We should throttle cleanup and avoid parallel deletions. Switch to an ionice/nice wrapper and limit to 2-4 concurrent workers. Also consider using find -delete with single-thread or rsync --remove-source-files pattern.
Maria: Staging change: replaced xargs -P 16 -> xargs -P 3 and wrapped with ionice -c3. Will monitor.
infra-bot: [alert] node i-0abcd1234 reported read-only remount at 1801234570 :red_circle:
AJ: Also saw network RX/TX errors on that node before remount. Might be NVMe controller reset + driver retries + network fasthpath contention.
Sam: Short term mitigation: cordon + taint affected nodes (taint=nvme:degraded) and drain vs. schedule rolling replacements. Set autoscaler to provision replacement with ebs-backed scratch or larger ephemeral SSDs.
Devon: Ops runbook updates needed:
- make ephemeral-cleaner run at low-concurrency with ionice
- add safe-delete flag to batch jobs (write to staging folder then atomic move)
- add nvme SMART monitoring alerts for prog_erase_count and media_errors
- auto-taint on two or more SMART warnings
Maria: Added ticket INF-4897 for runbook + rollout. Rolling reboot scheduled 03:45 after handover window. Will also roll nodes to i3en for next batch if wear persists.
AJ: Could we throttle disk-heavy batch jobs instead? Add rate-limiting at producer side or spill to S3 before deletion.
Sam: Yes, prefer write -> s3 async -> delete local copy. Ops can enable in config with SMALL_FILE_BUFFER=true for nightly jobs.
ops-bot: Scheduled job "ephemeral-cleaner" changed concurrency from 16 to 3 by Maria at 1801234575 :white_check_mark:
Maria: Monitoring: IOPS down 70% after change, no new read-only remounts in last 20m. Will keep watch and run SMART scan across fleet at 02:00 UTC.
Devon: If SMART scan shows high wear across many hosts, we'll propose instance-type switch and budget impact. FYI, capping concurrent deletions will increase the cleaner wall time ~4x, but reduces peak IO which is worth it.
AJ: Action items: cordon 3 nodes (Maria), run SMART fleet scan (Devon), update cleaner runbook + pipeline change (Sam/Devon), monitor for 24h (everyone). :eyes:
Maria: Thanks — will update thread with scan results. :thumbsup:
